description: Implementation of a service class for handling savings account applications, including creation, modification, approval, rejection, and GSIM-specific logic within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: SavingsApplicationProcessWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of savings application processing service with methods for handling savings account lifecycle events, including GSIM-specific logic.

methods.name: submitGSIMApplication
methods.description: Handles submission of multiple GSIM applications from a JSON array parameter.

methods.name: submitApplication
methods.description: Creates a new savings account application, including GSIM logic, account number generation, and event notification.

methods.name: modifyGSIMApplication
methods.description: Modifies GSIM-related savings accounts based on provided JSON command.

methods.name: modifyApplication
methods.description: Updates an existing savings account application with validation and data integrity checks.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes a savings account application after validation.

methods.name: approveGSIMApplication
methods.description: Approves a GSIM application and updates parent/child savings account statuses.

methods.name: approveApplication
methods.description: Approves a savings account application, including validation, event notification, and notes.

methods.name: undoGSIMApplicationApproval
methods.description: Reverts approval of a GSIM application, updating parent/child statuses.

methods.name: undoApplicationApproval
methods.description: Reverts approval of a savings account application.

methods.name: rejectGSIMApplication
methods.description: Rejects a GSIM application and updates parent/child statuses.

methods.name: rejectApplication
methods.description: Rejects a savings account application, including validation and event notification.

methods.name: applicantWithdrawsFromApplication
methods.description: Handles withdrawal of an applicant from a savings application.

methods.name: createActiveApplication
methods.description: Creates and activates a savings account application from data transfer object.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity exceptions during database operations.

methods.name: generateAccountNumber
methods.description: Generates and assigns an account number if required.

methods.name: checkClientOrGroupActive
methods.description: Validates that associated client or group is active.
